note: Landsbankinn's price list (25 August 2026), read in full for its personal credit cards on 2026-10-30: the general credit card (3,700 kronur a year), Gold card collecting Aukakrónur (14,400), Gold Vildarkort (14,400), Platinum card (24,900), Platinum Vildarkort (24,900) and Premium Vildarkort (44,000); the general card with gold travel insurance (6,900) is being phased out and takes no new applications, so it isn't written. Each: a balance spread over longer payments bears 15.70% a year, the one credit card rate in Landsbankinn's interest rate chart of 1 September 2026 (read 2026-10-29); a cash withdrawal on the card at a machine or bank in Iceland costs 2.20% plus the 120-krone withdrawal fee (2.75% abroad, at least 800 kronur, not written); the bank adds 2.30% to the wholesale VISA rate on every foreign card transaction; each statement paid by debit from an account costs 120 kronur, written as a monthly fee (120 kronur a month assumes one statement a month; paying by payment slip costs 300, not written); and a collection warning on a missed payment costs 950 kronur, written as the late fee. The 250-krone transaction fee for spreading a card payment and the limit-raise fees aren't written. The main banks: Landsbankinn, Arion banki and Íslandsbanki; only Landsbankinn, the largest, is written, the others' price lists not reached on 2026-10-30.
